context:
有人切了舊肉出來
不過辣個女人說的話是騙不了老OG的
考古一下就會發現從一開始就是彗醬在暈咪口
不過星街彗星有品牌形象要顧
所以在我看來反而是一種很可愛的傲嬌
但是HoloGTA時發生很多事情
可以說彗醬已經完全自爆了
生配信中突然打給咪口塞奶差點變放送事故
有幾次彗醬差點惹咪口生氣（不是演的）
然後彗醬超怕她生氣
馬上變成一隻很乖的小狗一樣
但最讓大家跌破眼鏡的肯定是
毫無抵抗的讓咪口抓去跳鋼管那次
然後我們再回頭看這個舊肉
星街的嘴
騙人的鬼

Ok so here we got a piece of old slice from that broadcast
But whatever that blue woman says will not trick us OGs
Dig into history and you will see clearly it was Suichan had a big crush on Mikochi first
However due to Suisei’s image branding she had to say that
Nevertheless, this is obviously all tsundere to me and I find that cute
A lot of things happened during HoloGTA
Suichan has exposed her true heart
There was that incident when Suichan called Miko and spoke so softly on the voicechat and thought she was offstream already
Then there were times when Miko got mad (literally mad) because Suichan did something silly
Suichan immediately noticed and started to behave like a little puppy in front of Miko because Suichan was so afraid if she’s made Miko mad
And the biggest shock must be
When Suichan surrendered so easily to Miko and just did that pole dance for her
Now let’s watch this clip again
Hoshimachi Suisei is such a con artist
